title: chenopodium hircinum f. laciniatum
intro: Chenopodium hircinum f. laciniatum, commonly known as a variety of the Goat's Beard plant, is a type of flowering plant within the Chenopodiaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to aid in reducing inflammation and improving digestion. Therapeutically, it is known to exhibit expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Chenopodium hircinum f. laciniatum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
